a series of novel 1H-pyranazole-5-carboxamide derivatives were designed and synthesized and some of them showed promising cytotoxic activities.
the new compounds 4Ia and 4IIa exhibited the most potent cytotoxicity against all the four cell lines tested, with the most significant activity against BGC823 cell line.
the new compounds 4Ib and 4Il showed the best antiproliferation activity against HepG2 cell lines and BT474 cell line, respectively.
